literal: Even though they are without fault, from departing the soft shoulders of those whom one loves, in that state a certain pleasure it possesses.
translation: Even though they are free of any fault, separating from the soft shoulders of the one we love has a unique pleasure of its own.
modern: அவர்கள் எந்தத் தவறும் செய்யாதவர் என்றாலும், நாம் விரும்பும் காதலியின் மென்மையான தோள்களை விட்டு விலகி இருப்பதில் ஒரு தனி இன்பம் இருக்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the sweet nature of feigned anger and temporary separation in love. The speaker explains that even when the beloved has done nothing wrong, there is a distinct, delightful pleasure in staying away from her soft shoulders for a brief moment. This distance is not caused by actual conflict, but is a playful pause that makes their eventual reunion even more joyful.
